adaptationNotes: Original Shadertoy: https://www.shadertoy.com/view/wl2Gzc. Ported to shaders/ember-drift and snippets/ember-sparks: terminal blending removed, width-normalized coordinates converted to height units, uninitialized locals zeroed, output tonemapped. Attribution kept in the body header.
name: Sparks From Fire
notes:
"Sparks from fire" by Jan Mróz (jaszunio15), https://www.shadertoy.com/view/wl2Gzc, licensed CC BY 3.0 (stated in the file header). Preserved here as adapted for Ghostty by Alex Sherwin (0xhckr/ghostty-shaders `85898f0`).

Generator: eight layers of rotating per-cell spark points with noise-warped UVs, layered value-noise smoke with holes and a vignette. The terminal texture is only sampled for the final blend, so the generator ports to a single pass directly.

origin.author: Jan Mróz (jaszunio15); Ghostty adaptation by Alex Sherwin

requirements: iChannel0 terminal texture used only for final blending (removable)
summary: Jan Mróz's CC BY 3.0 rising embers and smoke (Shadertoy wl2Gzc) via the Ghostty adaptation; source of the ember-drift scene.
